---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

This page explore the relationship between the Production budgets and the worldwide revenues of the 104 films @fig-budget-revenue.

::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production budget (millions of US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
